derivation.source: Original finest available NASA source triangles, not visual LoD
derivation.sampling: Vertical barycentric ray at each grid-cell center; maximum observed surface height
derivation.slope: Maximum contributing triangle slope and eight-neighbor height grade
derivation.resolutionMeaning: 0.25 m sampling interval, not an assertion of source stereo accuracy
derivation.startSelection: 30 degree, 0.5 m eroded component with at least 200 cells nearest local (3,3)
derivation.targetSelection: Same connected component near 15 m Euclidean distance
